comment: ANCHOR: DISK_MONITOR_20261030 — host-resident disk GROWTH monitor (scripts/disk_monitor.py, config/disk_monitor.json):
persistent baseline + per-mount/per-hotspot growth vs a rolling window, transition-only Telegram alerts (P2 warn /
P1 critical) via alert_condition_state dedupe, and a --dry-run that writes and sends nothing. It never deletes —
it reports the reviewed disk_hygiene reclaim. Hermetic: fake df/du, tmp home/state/alert paths, fake notify.
